description: Query same-name population counts (同名人数 / 重名查询). Given a name, a single call returns how many people share that name in a bundled, reproducible sample dataset; the result can be narrowed with --gender and/or --province and is then broken down by gender and province. When nothing matches, an explicit message is printed — the query never fails silently. Output is readable Markdown by default, with plain-text and JSON alternatives. Implemented with the Python 3 standard library only; it does not call the Huawei Cloud CLI, any Huawei Cloud SDK, or any REST API, and it touches no cloud resource. Triggers include: "查询同名人数", "同名同姓查询", "姓名重名", "重名查询", "同名查询", "查同名", "同名人数", "same name count", "name duplicate count", "count same name", "how many people share this name".
